title: 2026 Digital Trust Index: AI Adoption vs Consumer Confidence
discussion_signal: Thales frames digital trust as an access-layer experience shaped by sign-up and login friction, data handling, authentication, AI adoption, and consumer confidence. It presents autonomy and control as conditions for trust in AI acting on users’ behalf.
linked_research_question: How do identity friction, understandable data practices, and AI autonomy shape abandonment and confidence at the point of access?
limits: The post promotes a vendor-produced index
It does not independently validate the reported consumer outcomes
Security-product framing may favor authentication and access explanations over broader social trust factors
